title: Karachi Development Authority Sindh Amendment Act 1973

sections.shortTitle: Karachi Development Authority Sindh Amendment Act 1973
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VII OF 1973
ACT VII OF 1973
KARACHI
DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (SIND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973
An Act to amend
the Karachi Development Authority Order, 1957
[Gazette of Sind,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 29th June 1973]
(First published after having
received the assent of the Governor of Sind in the Gazette of Sind
(Extraordinary), dated 28th June 1973).
No. PAS/Legis-B-7/73.-The
Karachi Development Authority (Sind Amendment) Bill, 1973 having been passed by
the Provincial Assembly of Sind on the 6th June 1973, and assented to by the
Governor of Sind on the 27th June 1973 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sind :-
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Karachi Development Authority
(Sind Amendment) Act 1973.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
